## Invitations

A total of 526 invitations were issued during the outreach period. Attendance was recorded at 279 people, representing a rate of 53.0 per cent. These figures provide a summary of the response to the invitation activity and indicate the number of people who attended following contact.

The attendance result will support routine review of the outreach approach. It also provides a basis for considering how invitations and follow-up contact are being used to encourage participation.

## Contact

SMS contact was used for 458 invitations. The records show that 0 people received a reminder message. Staff continue to phone people who missed appointments, so that contact can be maintained and opportunities for attendance are not lost.

The contact information and attendance figures should be considered together when reviewing the outreach activity. The report was prepared by G. Evans.
